page.overview:
What is Heist on a Corellian shipyard?

A heist on a Corellian shipyard was undertaken by the White Worms to steal a Corellia shipyard's control boards around 13 BBY. However, the attempted endeavor was unsuccessful, leading to the deaths of many scrumrats.

The raid appeared in Crimson Climb, a 2023 young-adult novel written by E. K. Johnston.
